architecture.kernelExtractionLaw: Extract only responsibilities proven by execution friction and independent acceptance; large-function size alone does not create a new authority owner.
architecture.agentTurnProjector: AgentTurnProjector owns deterministic read-side construction of the exact Agent-visible request, including WorkingView/caller/Tool overlay order, addressability, Runtime Tool surface and request-bound Harness capabilities.
architecture.cognitionAdmissionKernel: CognitionAdmissionKernel owns the shared source-current structural admission law for caller promotion and ordinary WorkingSet transition. Action-specific progress/evidence meaning remains in the sequential Run coordinator.
architecture.providerCallLifecycle: ProviderCallLifecycle freezes the optional Provider-continuity surface at Loop construction, validates exact provider_request_digest identity for durable calls and normalizes begin/admit/fail/retry/complete bridge addressing.
architecture.providerPolicyBoundary: ProviderCallLifecycle owns neither retry/backoff policy nor Run stop semantics, token accounting, model semantic interpretation or physical transport. Those remain Loop/Adapter responsibilities; durable Provider truth remains Continuity authority.
architecture.constructorVerifierSeparation: Construction and execution ports do not certify their own durable truth. SQLiteHarnessRunContinuityStore remains the independent Journal/CAS verifier and was not modified by this extraction.
architecture.noProgressOwnership: The inherited no-progress ownership law remains current: Harness-owned NO_PROGRESS stops carry execution reason in stop detail/Trace and do not synthesize an Agent needs_input conclusion.
architecture.conclusionCorrectionCompatibility: Independent conclusion-correction budget remains request-visible through AgentTurnProjector; the final live trajectory exposed conclusionCorrections=5 on all three exact Provider requests.
architecture.nonServiceLaw: No Kernel Manager, Provider Manager service, generic Capability/Memory/RAG layer, SQLite schema, Protocol codec or recommended public API was added.

conclusion: The current R2 lineage has three complementary internal kernels. AgentTurnProjector constructs exact Agent-visible requests, CognitionAdmissionKernel admits source-current cognition mutations, and ProviderCallLifecycle normalizes optional durable Provider lifecycle identity/hooks. The Loop retains policy and action-specific semantics; Continuity remains independent verification authority. On the current no-progress ownership lineage _run is 1876 lines, the full 287-test/build gate passes, and real native-a DeepSeek promotion succeeds on the exact source.
knownLimits: OrdivonAgentLoop._run remains 1876 lines. Tool-effect/reconciliation, progress gates, conclusion validation and pause/stop assembly remain inside the coordinator until real friction demonstrates another boundary.
SQLiteHarnessRunContinuityStore remains 3837 lines and intentionally unchanged; constructor/verifier independence takes priority over superficial DRY.
ProviderCallLifecycle freezes bridge hook presence at Loop construction. Dynamic mutation of that surface is not a supported current contract.
All three kernels remain internal execution components rather than public APIs or global services.
No Runtime, World, Finance, Host or other Ordivon repository was changed by this extraction.
